content.title: The Boys
content.shortDescription: A group of vigilantes known informally as “The Boys” set out to take down corrupt superheroes with no more than blue-collar grit and a willingness to fight dirty.

content.title: The Name of the Game
content.shortDescription: When a Supe kills the love of his life, A/V salesman Hughie Campbell teams up with Billy Butcher, a vigilante hell-bent on punishing corrupt Supes, and Hughie’s life will never be the same again.

content.title: Cherry
content.shortDescription: The Boys get themselves a Superhero, Starlight gets payback, Homelander gets naughty, and a Senator gets naughtier.

content.title: Frieren: Beyond Journey's End
content.shortDescription: Elf mage Frieren and her fellow adventurers have defeated the Demon King and brought peace to the land. But Frieren will long outlive the rest of her former party. How will she come to understand what life means to the people around her?

content.title: The Journey's End
content.shortDescription: The world celebrates the Demon King's defeat at the hands of the Hero and his companions. Now that their great adventure is over, what will Frieren the mage do next?

content.title: It Didn't Have to Be Magic...
content.shortDescription: Frieren instructs Fern in the use of magic while deciphering a grimoire for Heiter.
